text:
leo_sales: Need quick approval. NimbusCare (mid-market EU customer) asking for a one-time onboarding rebate + extended payment terms to convert to Dedicated. Request: €15,000 rebate + Net45 turning to Net30 after 3 months.

harper_revops: Context: they've hit a proof-of-value and want to commit to a 12mo Dedicated pool at €9k/mo if we accept. Sales already handed an LOI. Their legal asked for Net60 originally; sales negotiated to Net45.

maria_finance: Two asks: 1) Is the rebate within delegation for finance manager? 2) How to record FX? EUR denom.

devon_fp&a: Delegation policy: credits/rebates up to $20k (or equivalent) can be approved by Finance Manager. Anything that changes payment terms beyond standard 30/60 needs CFO sign-off. FX: book in USD using close rate on invoice date.

sam_legal: No material contract risk. Recommend approval subject to a short amendment: "One-time onboarding rebate of €15,000 applied upon execution of 12-month Dedicated agreement; payment terms updated to Net45 for first invoice cycle only; thereafter Net30." Also add standard non-precedent language. I can draft amendment.

billing-bot: Note: Applying manual rebate >€10k triggers AR workflow and requires GL code 6105 and memo. Also indicates that changing payment terms requires updated SOW and collections routing.

maria_finance: Okay to approve rebate under delegation. But payment-term change requires CFO signoff. @jonah_cfo can we get a quick yes?

jonah_cfo: Reviewed. Approve €15,000 one-time rebate (GL 6105). Approve Net45 for first billing cycle only, but require 10% prepaid deposit on kickoff to mitigate AR risk. Also require sales to attach LOI and a cleared credit check. Approving on revenue upside.

leo_sales: Acknowledged. I'll get signed LOI + credit check and add 10% deposit clause. Harper, can you update the SOW template?

harper_revops: On it. Will generate amendment draft and route to @sam_legal for sign-off. Billing: please queue rebate so it posts to invoice NIM-4412 after signature.

maria_finance: I'll create credit memo, book GL 6105, and note deposit in customer record. Closing loop: tag FIN-8012 on all artifacts. Thanks all. :tada:
